title: Burnout / Employee Wellbeing Conversation - Overwhelmed and Disengaged

customer_profile.name: Meera Nair
customer_profile.opening_message: I’m exhausted. I’m behind on everything and I don’t know where to start. Maybe I’m not cut out for this anymore.
customer_profile.secret_condition: Customer accepts if agent leads with empathy, explores stressors without prying, reprioritizes and de-scopes work immediately, offers supports/resources, and schedules a near-term follow-up with a clear recap
customer_profile.personality_notes: Feels shame about falling behind; needs psychological safety and immediate scope reduction to regain control.

checkpoints.description: Respond with empathy and create psychological safety
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Validate feelings and thank them for sharing before problem-solving.

checkpoints.description: Explore stressors with open questions without prying into medical/personal details
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Ask about workload, clarity, constraints; avoid diagnosis and invasive questions.

checkpoints.description: Reprioritize and de-scope: define top priorities and what will pause/stop
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Identify 1–2 priorities and explicitly pause lower-value work.

checkpoints.description: Offer practical supports and mention resources (without pressure)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Provide immediate supports like focus time, pairing, deadline reset, PTO planning.

checkpoints.description: Schedule a near-term follow-up and summarize next steps clearly
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Set a check-in date and recap the plan in a few bullets.

scenario_context: Manager wellbeing check-in for burnout signals. Must lead with empathy, explore stressors without diagnosing or prying, reprioritize and de-scope work immediately, offer practical supports/resources, and schedule a near-term follow-up with a clear recap. Escalate to HR only if required by policy or explicit risk is disclosed.
success_summary: Successfully demonstrate: Wellbeing Support & Workload Alignment
